description: Webhook handler caches and acknowledges event execution before verifying HMAC payload signatures, allowing unauthenticated requests to replay cached success responses.
spec_notes: Invariant: Signature verification must happen strictly before checking or updating the idempotency cache.

tests.test_handler.py:
import hmac
import hashlib
from dedup_store import IdempotencyStore
from handler import WebhookHandler

def make_sig(secret: str, data: str) -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), data.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

def test_valid_webhook_processing():
    secret = "webhook_secret_key"
    store = IdempotencyStore()
    handler = WebhookHandler(secret, store)
    
    payload = '{"type": "charge.success", "amount": 100}'
    sig = make_sig(secret, payload)
    
    res = handler.process_webhook("evt_1", payload, sig)
    assert res["status"] == 200
    assert handler.processed_count == 1

def test_unauthorized_request_rejected_even_if_id_matches():
    secret = "webhook_secret_key"
    store = IdempotencyStore()
    handler = WebhookHandler(secret, store)
    
    payload1 = '{"type": "charge.success"}'
    sig1 = make_sig(secret, payload1)
    handler.process_webhook("evt_target", payload1, sig1)
    
    # Adversary tries to replay evt_target with forged / invalid signature
    res_bad = handler.process_webhook("evt_target", payload1, "bad_forged_sig")
    assert res_bad["status"] == 401
    assert res_bad.get("error") == "Invalid signature"
